summary: Privy, as its agent wallet CLI uses it: Privy holds the key and signs on request. Signing in (device authorization, tokens, the wallet session) passes. A request to sign typed data that an adapter covers is typed before this, by that adapter; every other signature or transaction is refused for now, since what Privy would sign is not typed here. Reads pass.

actions.refuse: a signature or transaction that no adapter covers is not typed yet
